title: GIO Dental
description: giodentalsl.com GIO Dental SL is a modern dental clinic and laboratory founded by Nigerian dentist Dr. Gift Nwachukwu Obiorah in Freetown, Sierra Leone, with an additional location in Koidu, Kono District. It is Sierra Leone's first fully integrated dental provider offering clinical treatment, a prosthetics laboratory, dental technology education and equipment repair under one brand. Services span general and cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics, oral surgery, custom prosthetics fabrication and community oral health programs. Led by founder Dr. Gio, the company trains local dental technicians and runs outreach campaigns to make premium dental care accessible across the country. Its vertical model combining treatment, manufacturing and education is unique in the Sierra Leonean healthcare market. It also provides equipment repair and supply services to other dental clinics in the region.
